verdict.rationale: Box documents first-party webhooks that monitor content for events and send notifications to a URL of your choice. Its docs also cover creating a V2 webhook that notifies your endpoint (for example, on file download) and compare V1 and V2 webhooks. These are registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented delivery details such as payload signature verification, retries and the full event-trigger list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to monitor Box content for events, and receive notifications to a URL of your choice when they occur.
